title: Grade 1 Mathematics
description: A complete Grade 1 mathematics scope covering operations, place value, measurement, time, data, and geometry.

units.label: Counting & Number Sense to 120
units.description: Build a reliable counting sequence and connect quantities, spoken numbers, and written numerals.

units.label: Addition & Subtraction Stories
units.description: Model the major Grade 1 addition and subtraction situations with objects, drawings, and equations.

units.label: How Addition & Subtraction Work
units.description: Use operation properties and fact relationships to reason efficiently.

units.label: Addition & Subtraction Within 20
units.description: Develop flexible strategies and fluent recall for foundational facts.

units.label: Equations & Unknowns
units.description: Understand equality and reason about missing values in addition and subtraction equations.

units.label: Tens, Ones & Two-Digit Numbers
units.description: Build place-value understanding by composing, decomposing, and comparing two-digit numbers.

units.label: Add & Subtract with Place Value
units.description: Use tens, ones, drawings, and operation properties to work with numbers within 100.

units.label: Length & Measurement
units.description: Compare, order, and measure lengths with equal-size units.

units.label: Time to the Hour & Half-Hour
units.description: Read and write time using analog and digital clocks.

units.label: Organize & Interpret Data
units.description: Sort data into categories and answer questions about the results.

units.label: Shapes & Equal Shares
units.description: Reason about shape attributes, compose shapes, and partition wholes into equal shares.
